title: Interior Casing, Trim Capping and Paint Inclusions by Installation Method — Installation Jobs Price Book
content:
This price book page sets what each installation method of **Installation Jobs** includes for new interior casing, exterior aluminum trim capping and interior paint, and the per-opening price figures where an item is not included.

| Installation method | New interior casing included | Interior casing per opening where not included (USD) | Exterior trim capping available | Exterior trim capping included | Exterior trim capping per opening where available and not included (USD) | Painting or staining of new interior trim included |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | No | 69.00 | Yes | No | 89.00 | No |
| Full-Frame Installation | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | No | 89.00 | No |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | Yes | 0.00 | No |
| Masonry Opening Installation | Yes | 0.00 | No | No | 0.00 | No |
| Bay and Bow Installation | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | No | 145.00 | No |
| Door System Installation | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | No | 79.00 | No |

## Notes to the page

- A per-opening figure of 0.00 means the item is included with the method (interior casing; capping under Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap) or, for capping under Masonry Opening Installation, that capping is not available with the method.
- Only Insert Pocket Installation leaves new interior casing out of the method; every other method includes it.
- Exterior trim capping carries a per-opening figure only under the four methods that offer it without including it: Insert Pocket Installation, Full-Frame Installation, Bay and Bow Installation and Door System Installation.
- No method includes painting or staining of new interior trim.

## Reading the page (hypothetical example)

For a hypothetical Door System Installation job, interior casing is part of the method (0.00), exterior trim capping is available but not included, and its per-opening figure is 79.00.
